div.div: أَجَلُّ [Thicker &c., and thickest &c.; see جَلِيلٌ: and] i. q. أَعْظَمُ [more, and most, great &c.]: (S, TA:) fem. جُلَّى. (Ham. p. 45.) With the article, [as a superlative epithet,] it is applied to God; (S, TA;) and so, by poetic license, الأَجْلَلُ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
